title: It Worked
author: Brennan Hatton

It worked.

%TARGET% is dead.

You werent there.
You were already dead.

Carriage %CARRIAGE%.

Something with your face,
in a world you never saw,
finishing what you started.

You dont have to feel good about it.

You know now.

Welcome back to the Dungeon Train

%STORY%

I am paper.
I am rarely right.

That one was.

Sleep well.
